home.heroTitle: Loved toys, ready for a second childhood
home.heroText: We buy back educational toys children have outgrown, restore them and pass them on. Good for the planet, good for your wallet.

how.title: Families send us toys
how.text: Parents whose children have outgrown their toys fill in a short form and ship them to us.

how.title: We restore and check
how.text: Every item is cleaned, checked for missing parts and repaired where needed.

how.title: You pick and we deliver
how.text: Choose from our shop, pay online and get the toys at your door or pick them up.

ourStory.title: Our story
ourStory.intro: We are a small team in Amsterdam who believe good toys deserve more than one childhood.
ourStory.missionText: Educational toys are built to last, yet most are used for a year or two before ending up in a cupboard or a landfill. We give them a second life: families pass them on, we restore them, and other families get quality toys for a fair price.

values.title: Honesty
values.text: We describe every toy's condition exactly as it is and show real photos.

values.title: Quality
values.text: Only complete, clean and safe toys make it to the shop.

values.title: Less waste
values.text: Every toy we resell is one fewer produced and one fewer thrown away.

ourStory.contactText: Questions about an order or a toy you would like to pass on? Write to us at hello@example.com.

sellToUs.title: Sell your toys
sellToUs.intro: Has your child outgrown their toys? Pass them on to a new family and get paid for it.

how.title: Tell us what you have
how.text: Fill in the form below with a short description of the toys and your contact details.

how.title: We make an offer
how.text: Within two working days we reply with a price or ask for a couple of photos.

how.title: Ship or drop off
how.text: Send the toys to us or bring them to our point in Amsterdam. We pay once they arrive.

sellToUs.acceptText: Wooden and plastic educational toys, construction sets, puzzles, musical instruments, role-play sets and children's books. Complete, clean and without safety recalls.

faq.a: Typically 30–50% of the resale price, depending on condition and demand. We tell you the amount before you ship.

faq.q: What if a piece is missing?
faq.a: Tell us in the form. Some sets are fine with a piece missing, others are not; we will let you know.
We do. After accepting the offer you get a prepaid label.
Of course. Just mention it in the message and we will put the toys into circulation for free.
